title: Bulk invite partial failure semantics
answers: What happens when one row of a bulk invite fails?
Why do retried invites send duplicate emails?
body:
`OrganizationInviteViewSet.bulk`: `serializer.is_valid()` runs on the whole list first (all-or-nothing on field validation); `first_bulk_invite_error` returns only the first failing row's error.
But `save()` calls `create` per row with NO `transaction.atomic()`. The already-a-member check lives in `create`, so a late such row raises after earlier rows were created and emailed -> 400 with some invites persisted.
Duplicate emails in one request: `OrganizationInviteManager.delete_existing_invites` in each create, so last wins (`combine_pending_invites` default False; client never sets it).
Client: `inviteLogic` resets `invitesToSend` only on `inviteTeamMembersSuccess`; after failure rows remain, so retry re-creates already-saved invites (second email, first link deleted).
Analytics: `report_team_member_invited` per row; `report_bulk_invited` once, skipped if save() raised.
applies: Bulk endpoint invites/bulk/ only; validation-stage failures save nothing, create-stage failures do.
says: I invited ten people but only some of them received invitations
Some team members got duplicate invite emails in one request
Bulk invites fail for one person but others already invited
Can I retry failed bulk invites without resending to others
Bulk invite partially succeeds but doesn't say which rows failed
search: Bulk invite partial failure semantics: serializer.is_valid() validates all-or-nothing upfront, but save() creates invitations per row without transaction.atomic(), so already-a-member checks in create() raise after earlier rows are persisted and emailed, returning 400 with partial success. Duplicate emails in one request trigger delete_existing_invites per create, so last email wins; client retries re-create already-saved invites by keeping failed rows in invitesToSend. Analytics reports team_member_invited per row and bulk_invited once, skipping the latter on save() failure. Applies only to invites/bulk/ endpoint; validation-stage failures save nothing, create-stage failures do. Relevant files: posthog/api/organization_invite.py (OrganizationInviteViewSet.bulk, OrganizationInviteManager.delete_existing_invites), frontend/src/scenes/settings/organization/inviteLogic.ts.
